prompt: A handsome young male with glowing tanned skin stands facing the camera directly in a confident, formal stance with shoulders relaxed back to open his chest. He wears a black unbuttoned long-sleeve shirt, a silver chain necklace, and black wayfarer-style sunglasses that completely obscure his eyes, pairing perfectly with his serious, neutral expression. His brown, medium-length hair is styled in a slicked-back flow reaching the nape of his neck and tucked neatly behind his ears, with moderate volume at the front quiff and lying flat on the sides. The hair shows dark blonde and brown roots transitioning to lighter blonde ends, held tightly by a heavy, wet-look pomade that creates a glossy, structured appearance with slight separation of hair clumps, natural unevenness at the hairline, and minor flyaways visible on the right side of his head. At his lower torso, his hands are gently clasped together in a relaxed manner; his left hand rests underneath with fingers naturally curled inward, while his right hand lightly grasps the left knuckles, showcasing silver rings and a silver chain bracelet. He stands on a deck made of faded warm grey and brown wooden boards running diagonally, backed by a midground infinity pool featuring pristine dark water that reflects the vibrant twilight sky and his dark clothing. To the midground right, a classic stone balustrade with architectural spindles is silhouetted against the water, while an overhead foreground pine tree branch drapes lightly into the frame, its dark needles catching faint edges of the flash. The deep background spans into an expansive coastal landscape with dark silhouetted hills rising against an atmospheric twilight sky, where scattered coastal building lights softly glow on the far left shoreline. The scene is illuminated by mixed lighting, defined by a hard, direct on-camera flash that casts highly directional, warm golden light onto the subject, creating bright specular highlights on his forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, chest, hands, and metallic jewelry. This harsh flash produces deep black, short, tight shadows under his chin, inside his shirt folds, and beneath his clasped hands, contrasting dramatically against the moody, low-key ambient twilight of the background, which transitions smoothly from a magenta-purple sunset warmth into a deep dark navy blue night sky. The split-complementary color palette of warm flash tones against cool, desaturated atmospheric blues and purples evokes a mysterious, exclusive luxury resort atmosphere. Captured with the realistic digital photography style of high-end paparazzi lifestyle imagery, the shot is taken straight on at eye level using a 35mm to 50mm equivalent lens, employing a dragged shutter around 1/60s to balance the tack-sharp subject against the slightly softer, digitally noisy low-light background. Post-processing emphasizes slightly crushed blacks for high contrast and pushes sharpness and clarity on the subject's face and jewelry, with the entire striking composition framed in a 3:4 vertical portrait format.

translations.zh: 一名帅气的年轻男子，皮肤呈健康微光古铜色，以自信挺拔的姿态正对镜头，双肩自然舒展。他身着一件解开纽扣的黑色长袖衬衫，佩戴银质链条项链与黑色旅行者式太阳镜，表情严肃平静。他的中长棕发向后梳成大背头，发尾齐颈，耳后打理得整齐利落，发根略带深棕与金棕色，使用湿发发蜡定型。双手自然交叠在腹前，展示着银戒指与银手链。他站在呈对角线延伸的浅灰褐色木栈道上，身后是一座映衬着暮色天空与泳池倒影的无边泳池。远处是薄暮下的沿海山丘与海湾夜景。直打闪光灯照亮主体，营造出明亮的局部高光与硬朗阴影，与背景深邃的蓝紫色暮光形成鲜明冷暖对比，呈现出逼真的狗仔生活风时尚人像摄影质感。
